skill.summary: Tương tác với Pancake Platform API để quản lý pages, conversations, messages, customers, statistics, tags, posts, users. Sử dụng khi cần (1) Quản lý pages và tạo access token, (2) Xử lý conversations và messages, (3) Quản lý thông tin customers, (4) Xem statistics và analytics, (5) Quản lý tags và posts, (6) Quản lý users/staff, (7) Upload media content, (8) Chat plugin operations.

latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release with full Pancake Platform API interaction:

- Manage pages, conversations, messages, customers, tags, posts, users, statistics, and media uploads.
- Provides ready-to-use bash script (`scripts/pancake.sh`) for common API operations (GET/WRITE).
- Includes user and page access token setup, with clear security guardrails for write actions.
- Supports various endpoints for sales channel management, analytics, and chat plugin messaging.
- Detailed usage instructions and examples included in the documentation.
